title: Inequalities Involving Core, Corona, and Critical Sets in General Graphs
summary: Let $α(G)$ denote the cardinality of a maximum independent set. An independent set $I$ of $G$ is critical if $\left|I\right|-\left|N(I)\right|\ge\left|J\right|-\left|N(J)\right|$ for every independent set $J$ of $G$. Let $\text{core}(G)$ and $\text{corona}(G)$ be the intersection/union of all maximum independent sets of $G$. Let $\text{ker}(G)$ and $\text{diadem}(G)$ be the intersection/union of all critical independent sets of $G$.
